name: tuning-knobs
description: Visually tune a frontend component's parameters with knobs and switches, then write the values back into your code.

plugins.name: tuning-knobs
plugins.description: Build a throwaway interactive harness with knobs, sliders, and switches to dial in a component's spacing, sizing, color, shadow, and motion by eye — then write the chosen values straight back into the real source. The closed-loop alternative to nudging numbers one at a time in chat.
